description: Find an ERC-8004 agent on Base by name, wallet address or part of its id, when you don't have its exact id: the first step of a reputation check. Up to 10 matches, best first, each with verdict, score and flag count; then call check_agent with the id for the full scorecard. Free within the per-IP allowance.

query.description: A name ("Osobot"), a wallet (0x followed by 40 hex characters) or part of an id ("base:145").

name: find_agent

category.description: Non-scoring label from existing research or verified Bazaar tags; absent when unknown.

category_note.description: Risk disclaimer for trading, DeFi, prediction markets and airdrops.

description.description: Enhanced description combining research and available Bazaar claims (paid agent pages/export only).

description_bazaar.description: Paid only. Up to three matched Bazaar claims and provenance; first claim supplies the public preview.

description_note.description: Free response only: paid-access note, or null when no enhanced profile exists.

description_preview.description: One sentence from a verified-linked Bazaar listing; provider claim, unverified. Never research text.

description_research.description: Paid only. Supplied research findings, including identity caveats and their date; never scoring evidence.

usdc_atomic_clean.description: Clean USDC in exact atomic units (6 decimals).

more.description: Free page only: the paid call that answers more, with its cost.

title: Find an agent
